data.narrative:
Standard Bots, a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Evan Beard and David Golden, is evaluated against a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable in the robotics sector. The four most directly relevant private comparables—Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C)—span a valuation range of $1.0B to $1.8B.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised of $200M as a proxy baseline with a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $380M. Peer-median analysis across the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range from $1.0B to $1.8B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $323M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $1.0B. This wide range reflects material tension between stage-based valuation growth and peer-market pricing. The peer-median method carries greater weight given direct comparability; however, valuation uncertainty remains substantial pending clarity on Standard Bots' revenue, unit economics, customer concentration, and competitive positioning relative to the named peer set.
